keyword: how to apologize to your boyfriend

reviews.summary: The four parts and the family-fight sample fit the day after a fight, but the post never gave the text to send this morning when the big apology has to wait until tonight.

The study and template claims check out, but 'research behind the order' overclaimed (the study ranked elements, not their order), the Paper Crane note echoed thinking-of-you-messages-for-him, and the ES had 'si te fallarían' and 'nuestras cosas bonitas… tienen'.
The four parts, decision table and specific samples beat page one's loose tip lists, but there was no step for listening while he answers and the big-mistake heading had no search words.

applied: New: a morning text that names it and asks for the talk, with a sample (EN and ES).
New: 'Then listen' — let him finish, say back what you heard, leave unfair points for another day (EN and ES).
'Research behind which parts matter most' / «Hay estudios sobre qué partes pesan más».
Paper Crane note rewritten so it no longer echoes the other post, with 'a short line each' (EN and ES).
Heading 'How to apologize after a big fight or when you've really hurt him' / «Cómo pedirle perdón después de una pelea fuerte…».
ES: «si crees que te fallarían los nervios al decirla», «nuestra guía de… tiene una sección».

Polish taken: heading 'Apologize over text, in person or in a letter?'; 'What he said in the same fight' added to what not to say; the crying line now returns to how he feels; Text Thread note says lines are typed back in and ends on your own words; 'our post on'; ES «pedirle a domicilio su comida favorita… o», «Voy a recuperar tu confianza».
rejected: An extra text-length sample for a hurtful comment: the new morning text covers that case.

reviews.summary: The morning text is exactly the line to send today; four parts on one example, a listen step and a decision table beat page one's loose tips.
Every claim checks out, including the study ranking with its workplace caveat; all round-1 fixes landed, no reused sentences, and the Spanish reads as Spain Spanish in her voice.
Both round-1 fixes landed; the headings now carry the 'after a big fight' and 'over text' variants, with no overlap with the boyfriend post or the queued girlfriend apology post.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied: moving the morning text before the talk (reader, editor); a line on tone and phone face down (search); 'picked my friends', «cuando os veáis» and the ES Text Thread note wording (editor).
